items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: No, no. I never played with the bunk.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with the bunk or so on?

No, no. I never played with the bunk. No. Well, I remember hearing about him those days and everything, but I mean, I was in Chicago when they picked him up and then he took over with George Lewis Band. I was in Chicago.
